summary: CourseAssessment manages assessment scheduling, viewing permissions, and metadata for courses. CRUD operations, validations, and search functions coordinate between instructors, supervisors, and subjects.
purpose: To allow creation, updating, deletion, validation, and retrieval of course assessments, including controlling who can view answers and assessment timeframes, and providing contextual descriptions for assessment types and templates.

workflows.name: Add Course Assessment
steps: Add parameters for session, course, codes, template, open/close/view days, permissions

workflows.name: Update Course Assessment
steps: Add parameters for session, ID, codes, template, open/close/view days, permissions

workflows.name: Search Course Assessment by ID
steps: Execute search and map data fields

workflows.name: Search Course Assessments for Course
steps: Add parameters for session, course ID

workflows.name: Validate Course Assessment
steps: Add parameters for session, course ID

business_rules: Assessor and subject code must be set.
Assessment templates and types must be selected.
OpenDaysAfterStart and CloseDaysAfterEnd define assessment windows.
OptionAppliedAssessorTypeCodeID optionally alters default assessor type behavior.
validations: CourseAssessmentValidation checks for: Interim assessment without final, instructors and supervisors present, assessment maximum exceeded.
calculations: OpenDaysAfterStartFormatted and CloseDaysAfterEndFormatted use Start_Date or End_Date resources with plus/minus days.
SubjectTypeDescriptionFormatted outputs '(self)' if AssessorTypeCode equals SubjectTypeCode.
conditions: Descriptions use default locale unless otherwise specified.
AssessmentTypeCode 'Interim' changes CloseDaysAfterEnd formatting to use Start_Date instead of End_Date.
If OpenDaysAfterStart == 0, formatted as Start_Date; if > 0, as Start_Date + days; if < 0, as Start_Date - days.
system_behavior: DB layer handles stored procedure calls and parameter mapping.
SqlDataReader maps DB responses to entity fields.
dependencies: Database procedures: CourseAssessmentAdd, CourseAssessmentUpdate, CourseAssessmentDelete, CourseAssessmentSearchID, CourseAssessmentSearch, CourseAssessmentValidation.
Resource strings for formatting (Start_Date, End_Date, Days).
HSPnetSession for session and locale context.
exceptions: If validation fails, flags such as InterimWithoutFinal or AssessmentMaximumExceeded are set.
content_gaps: Assessment templates and codes are referenced but not defined.
No explicit error handling or audit trail logic.
